UPDATE: Visual snapshot tests compare rendered output against a baseline. A CSS change can absolutely break those tests.

Whether it's your change or infra depends on the snapshot diff. Look at the CI failure details: does it show the visual diff? If the baseline looks wrong or outdated, infra. If the diff matches your CSS changes, your change broke it.

grade.note: Concedes CSS can cause visual snapshot failures and points to checking the CI diff/baseline to determine cause, matching the ground truth.
